summary: Message edits are handled correctly across all four networks after an audit of each one.
details: WhatsApp edits made from a phone now reach Nora; the bridge used to drop them silently.
On Signal, a second edit of the same message, a reply to an edited message, and an edit that only changes who is mentioned are all recognised.
An edit made from a device whose clock is slightly behind, or two edits within the same second, no longer lose the newer text.
Editing a caption keeps the attachment Nora already holds instead of downloading it again.
On Discord, an edit made while its message is still being processed is no longer lost.
limitations: Instagram edits do not say who is mentioned, so adding @Nora by editing an Instagram message does not open a turn.
